name: A Valkyrie and a Songbird
source:
May and Ariel were once the center of each other's worlds. Then May left without a word, shattering Ariel. Now she's back, turning Ariel's world upside down once more.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
梅和阿里爾曾經是彼此世界的中心。後來梅不辭而別，讓阿里爾的心碎了。現在她回來了，阿里爾的世界也再一次因她而天翻地覆。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
